<ic>Permission to raise a fortress in the territory of Miekarova to defend against possible threats from the Northern Barbarians<br><br>''Proposed by Volodmartz, seconded by Zenith''</ic> 

===Overview===
* The creation of a new [[fortification]], currently unnamed, in [[Miekarova]].
* This motion was defeated.

===Date===
* Winter 378YE

===Costs===
* Materials: 80 [[Bourse#White_Granite|white granite]] and 20 Thrones. ([[Fortification#costs|Standard costs]]).
* Time: 1 year to construct
* Upkeep: 10 Thrones per season.

===Progress===
None

===Campaign Outcome===
This would have allowed the construction of a rank one fortification in Miekarova.
